title: A Tribute to Shri M. M. Patel (Saheb) | LDRP-ITR
text:
Shri
Maneklal Patel was born on 1st February, 1929 in village Untawa near Kadi in Mehsana district. He graduated in Arts and acquiredÂ degree of L.L.B. He also passed examination of Bar council and got the license to be lawyer. Even though, he was capable of being good lawyer, he chose to be Chief Officer of Kadi Municipality in 1958. During the span of 14 years and 10 months, he took lot of courageous and corrective steps to develop Kadi as a town. He was also one of the pioneering members to revive General Hospital at Kadi. He worked as a President of a charitable trust of the hospital and equipped it with lot of modern medical facilities. To promote oil and cotton ginning business around Kadi, he did lot of efforts to establish Kadi Nagarik Sahakari Bank with the purpose of lending loan to small scale industry around Kadi. He also served as a President of Kadi Oil Mill Ownerâs Association and successfully presented their issues to the Government for the benefit of oil mill owners and workers. Apart from this, he worked as President of Kadva Patidar Kelvani Uttejak Mandal and trustee of Gujarat Gaushala at Kadi.
Shri M. M. Patel was vigorously engaged in the field of education. He worked as a Chairman of Sarva Vidyalaya Kelvani Mandal for four decades. During his span, he started and nurtured many school and colleges with right pursuit of modern education. Due to his endless efforts, presently, SVKM consists of more than 65000 students studying in 65 different disciplines from KG to PhD in one campus at Kadi and two campuses situated at Gandhinagar. As a result of his modest efforts and continuous engagement, Kadi Sarva Vishwvidyalay achieved the status of University in the year 2008 under the University Act of state government of Gujarat. Considering his valuable contribution to education and philanthropic philosophy, he was invited by the State Government of Gujarat as a member of fee regulatory committee to represent various management institutes of Gujarat.
As a true educationalist, he firmly believed that no one should face problem of getting education due to monetary constraints. Every year, he forgo hefty amount in terms of fee relaxation for the economically poor students. Apart from this, he has also created Student Welfare Fund for assisting economically poor students. He had always raised the voice in vested interest of students and education fraternity.
He proved himself as bright student, carrying family member, successful businessman, true educator, modest philantropher throughout his life. He will be always remembered as the source of inspiration for philanthropic principles across the state of Gujarat.

It is our benign endeavor to create global technical leaders with all around technical skills to become a treasured asset of the nation. We work closely with our corporate community sharing information and developing a clear understanding of their recruitment needs. We collaborate with industry through internships, projects, industrial visits, impaneling industry professionals as visiting faculty and corporate based curriculum design. This enables us to put forward industry ready recruits to local, national and international corporations.

I am sure these âChange Mastersâ will be valuable assets of your organizations. The demand of the current time is to meet International standards. We provide the platform where students can grow dynamically before entering into the competitive world. The youth has that potential.

text:
Faculties
About Department
Established in 2005, the Computer Engineering department of LDRP Institute of Technology and Research offers Bachelor of Engineering (B. E.) and Master of Engineering (M. E.) programmes in Computer Engineering. The undergraduate B. E. programme is current intake of 180 students where as the M. E. is having the intake of 18. Admissions to both these programmes are carried out by the Government nominated admission committee (http://jacpcldce.ac.in). The department has adequate and well-qualified doctorate faculty members who also act as supervisors for Ph.D. programme being run by affiliating university viz. Kadi Sarva Vishwavidyalaya (https://ksvuniversity.org.in/). Active research and post-graduate dissertation is being carried out in department under various facets viz. Cloud computing, data/web mining, networking, image processing, soft computing, IoT etc. Equipped with latest tools and hardware, the department offers state of the art infrastructures to its students for their all round development. Collaboration of various significant stakeholders such as alumni, industry, academia and parents, department resolute to offer all aspects of teaching learning process before the students. Various curricular, co-curricular and extra-curricular activities provide platform to the students to grow freely.
Department Images
Vision Mission
Vision of Department:
To become a distinguished department of computer engineering to create proficient engineers with strong technical background including high ethical values which a responsible citizen of nation should have.
Mission of Department:
To teach and prepare computer professionals those meet not only the professional requirements but also technically aid in offering better life style for humanity.
To provide most up-to-date curricular and to provide adequate teaching learning infrastructure and environment to aspirant engineers which leads to innovation, problem solving skills, leadership eminence and moral accountability.

The Department of civil engineering has been functioning since 2011 and has grown into a full-fledged department with specializations in all the major areas of Civil Engineering. Civil Engineering deals with creating designs, constructing and maintaining physical structures including rails, roads, bridges, buildings, dams, etc. Civil Engineering is one of the highly critical engineering domains where a perfectly built structure can facilitate people with much comfort but a minor mistake made by an engineer can take away hundreds of lives in seconds. So, deep knowledge and perfect understanding of the concepts and requirements of civil engineering is highly desirable. About Department
The Department of Mechanical Engineering came in to being in the year 2005.
Admissions to U.G. and P.G. programmes are carried out by the Government nominated admission committee (http://jacpcldce.ac.in).
At present, Department offers undergraduate and postgraduate courses as follows:
B.E.[Mechanical Engineering]Â  Â  Â  Â  Â  Â  Â  Â  Â  Â  Â  Â  Â  Â :Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  60

M.E.[Mechanical â Thermal Engineering]Â  Â  Â  :Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â  12
Also, the Department has a Skill Development Centre in the area of CNC/VMC with modern facilities in CAD/CAM along with due approval from The Centre for Entrepreneurship Development (Government of Gujarat) since 2017.
The department has well equipped laboratory and workshop facilities with modern sophisticated equipment to carry out research in all areas related to Mechanical Engineering.
Head of Department
It is my immense pleasure to welcome you to the departments of Mechanical Engineering. Mechanical engineering is one of the oldest and broadest engineering disciplines. It involves the use of engineering physics, mathematics, and materials science to design, analyze, manufacture, and maintain mechanical systems. Mechanical engineers have an important role to play in practically every industry; be it automotive, aerospace, chemical, process, electronics or software. Be it sports, medical or any product development; mechanical engineers contribute to it substantially.
Department of Mechanical Engineering well equipped with state-of-art laboratory infrastructure and softwares like AutoCAD, SOLID EDGE, Pro-E and UGNX, The department also trains students for latest simulation software- COMSOL Multiphysics and analysis software -ANSYS. The department is equipped with conventional machine tools like Lathe ,Milling, Drilling,Grinding machines as well as Latest technology machine tools like 4-Axis VMC, CNC turning Centre/Lathe etc..,The department holds state of the art welding simulator and metallurgy laboratory.
Department of Mechanical Engineering has adequate and well-qualified doctorate faculty members who also act as supervisors for Ph.D. programs being run by affiliating university viz. Kadi Sarva Vishwavidyalaya (https://ksvuniversity.org.in/). Our faculties are continuously attending various training programs, publishing research papers, books and filing patents. Many are pursuing research. Our departments have been conducting seminars / conferences/workshops to keep the faculty and students updated as per the needs of industries.
The core values of the departments is to help the students to develop their overall personality and make them worthy to compete and work at global level. Sound support to Student Research, BAJA, SUPRA, efficycle etc. to develop all-round personality of our students with different co-curricular & extracurricular activities. Regular activities are arranged and encouraged in the departments for indigenous product development, skills enhancement and interdisciplinary interactions.
I welcome you to the Mechanical Engineering departments and be a part of our journey towards nation building.
Faculties have been actively participating in research and consultancy work.
Vision Mission
Vision :
To impart nationally and internationally recognized education in Mechanical Engineering, leading to well-qualified engineers who are innovative contributors to the profession and successful in advanced studies and research.
Mission :
Impart quality education and training to nurture globally competitive mechanical engineers. Provide vital state-of-the-art research facilities to create, interpret, apply and disseminate quality and globally acceptable education based on innovation and academic excellence.
Develop linkages with world class educational institutions and R&D organizations for excellence in teaching, research and consultancy services with ethical values making positive contributions to the society and thereby for sustainable growth of humanity.
Laboratories
“The laboratories are well-equipped with advanced machines, tools, equipment, and software to enhance the classroom teaching and learning experience.”
Â
CAD/CAM
Computer-Aided Design (CAD) and Computer-Aided Manufacturing (CAM) technologies enable efficient product development. CAD/CAM software is used for designing and manufacturing prototypes, creating finished products, and simulating production runs.The CAD/CAM Center is equipped with advanced machinery, including a CNC Lathe Vertical Machining Center, Additionally, it features industry-relevant software such as Creo Parametric, SOLIDEDGE (NX CAD), ANSYS.
Theory of Machine & Dynamics Laboratory
Â
The Dynamics Laboratory is equipped with various experimental setups, including an FFT Analyzer, Universal Vibration Apparatus, Dynamic Balancing Machine, Universal Governor Apparatus, Motorized Gyroscope, Whirling of Shaft Apparatus, Cam Analysis Apparatus, Single Rotor and Two Rotor System, and Epicyclic Gears These instruments facilitate the practical verification of fundamental theoretical principles in kinematics and machine dynamics.
Robotics & IOT
The Robotics & IoT Lab in the Mechanical Engineering Department fosters innovation in automation, AI, and smart systems. Equipped with cutting-edge technology, it enables students to design, program, and prototype intelligent machines. The lab supports research in robotics, IoT applications, and industry 4.0 solutions, bridging academia and real-world advancements.
Measurement & Instrumentation
The Measurement & Instrumentation Lab equips students with hands-on experience in precision measurement techniques and instrument calibration. It features advanced devices like strain gauges, thermocouples, pressure transducers, and digital measuring instruments. This lab enhances students’ understanding of metrology, error analysis, and sensor technology, essential for accurate data acquisition in engineering applications.
Renewable Energy Laboratory
Well equipped renewable energy laboratory with modern infrastructure for solar & wind energy. Real Time Infrastructure projects did by faculties & research scholars for academic & research.
Heat TransferÂ  Laboratory
The Heat Transfer Laboratory is equipped with various setups to demonstrate fundamental heat transfer principles, including Fourierâs law of heat conduction, natural and forced convection, Stefan-Boltzmann law, critical radius, and extended surfaces with natural and forced convection. Additionally, the laboratory features an indigenously developed wind tunnel facility for studying and analyzing aerodynamic objects
Fluid Mechanics Laboratory
The Fluid Mechanics Laboratory is equipped with various turbines, pumps, and experimental setups to provide practical verification of fluid mechanics and hydraulic machine principles. It facilitates flow measurement and calibration using devices such as venturi meters, orifice meters, and test rigs for analyzing flow losses due to friction and pipe fittings. Additionally, the laboratory enables the study of performance characteristics of different turbomachines.
Material Science and Metallurgy Laboratory
Engineering metrology applies measurement science to manufacturing processes, ensuring the accuracy of measuring instruments, their calibration, and quality control of manufactured components.
The Metrology and Instrumentation Laboratory is equipped with advanced measurement and calibration instruments, including a profile projector, toolmakerâs microscope, optical interferometer, calibration micrometer, electronic comparator, slip gauge sets, dead weight pressure gauge, surface plate, micrometers, and vernier calipers
Refrigeration and Air-Conditioning Laboratory
The Refrigeration and Air-Conditioning Laboratory is equipped to demonstrate the principles, construction, and applications of refrigeration and air-conditioning systems.The laboratory features various refrigeration and air-conditioning equipment, including a vapor-compression refrigeration test rig, auto-defrosting refrigerator, split air-conditioner test rig, window AC, air cooler, evaporative cooler, cascade refrigerator, vapor absorption refrigerator, and heat pump.
Automobile engineering
The Automobile Engineering Lab provides hands-on experience in vehicle dynamics, engine testing, and automotive systems. Equipped with modern diagnostic tools, engine models, and simulation software, it enables students to analyze and innovate in the automotive sector, bridging the gap between theoretical knowledge and practical applications in vehicle design and performance.
Modernize workshop
The Central Workshop is a vital unit of the institute, where students gain hands-on experience in using various hand tools and equipment to manufacture practical products. In addition to supporting undergraduate, postgraduate, and PhD research projects, it also facilitates fabrication work for student competitions such as SAE-BAJA, E-BAJA.
First-year undergraduate students acquire essential manufacturing skills through practical training in fitting, carpentry, welding, soldering, plumbing, machining, smithy, and sheet metal workshops. This hands-on experience builds confidence for future product design and manufacturing activities. Additionally, the workshop provides maintenance support for various laboratories across the university campus.
Activities
Every year, all semester, students get exposure to futuristic developments and research oriented upgrades available across industries by Expert talks, Seminars and Webinars. The experts from various industries i.e.Â  CAD/CAM , automation , CAE, HVAC, Automobile engineering , Nano science, Additive Manufacturing etcâ¦gives expert talk to students.
Industry Visits
Every year, all semester, students visit Industries and reputed organizations. The exposure to the organisations like ISRO-Indian Space Research Organisation – Ahmedabad, IACE-International Automobile Centre of Excellence-Gandhinagar, SPRERI- Sardar Patel Renewable Energy Research Institute – Anand, etc.. improves thought process and subject understanding of students. Along with it students also visit industries like S.T. Workshop, , Accurate Engineering- , MAHAGUJARAT Foundry , Keepsake automation ,ICEMAKE Pvt. Ltd, etcâ¦to learn more about manufacturing practices and developments going on in industries.
INDUSTRIAL TRAININGS:
Every year, pre final and year, students receive industrial training and internships across variousÂ Â  Industries, reputed organizations and MNC. The level of training or internship are starting from shop floor training to managerial internships. The students get trained at reputed casting industries, automation industries, HVAC industries,Â  automobile manufacturerâs service layouts, Ports , Manufacturing industries ,fabrication industries, CNC machine manufacturing industries etc.Â  and gets certified for the training on a regular basis.

MCA Admission FAQ
What is MCA? Why is it good after graduation?
M.C.A (Master of Computer Application) is a two-year post graduate
AICTE
approved professional degree in Computer Applications from 2020 admissions onwards.
Yes, it is good to do an MCA after graduation, because only the graduation is not sufficient for knowledge, skill and job prospects.
Should I join my career / job, after Bachelor Degree only?
You may but, It is not advisable. Many IT companies are offering jobs after BCA or BSc (IT/CE) with reasonable salary packages. But, when high skill required or promotion is considered, all the companies ask for a Master Degree to be completed.
What are the career opportunities after doing M.C.A.?
Today’s is the age of computers. As an M.C.A you can,
Work as a System Analyst in a big company
Develop software for companies like Microsoft
Work as a Systems Manager in a big corporate
Work as an Internet Expert, Web Designing Specialist
Work as an entrepreneur
Take up a career in computer education
Work as a consultant
Go for Consultancy and Computer Education
Participate in Systems Development
Join Internet based companies and do Web Designing
Provide solutions to your clients and design-customized software
Develop Platforms for Software / Server based companies
Work as a troubleshooter for some top-notch computer companies
Design vast networks for clients like Indian Railways
What is the eligibility criteria for an MCA course?
Passed BCA/ B. Sc. (Computer/IT) / BE (Any branch) or equivalent Degree. OR
Passed B.Sc./B.Com./ B.A. with Mathematics at 10+2 Level or at Graduation Level (with additional bridge Courses as per the norms of the concerned University). AND
Obtained at least 50% marks (45% marks in case of candidates belonging to reserved category) in the qualifying Examination.
Why MCA@LDRP?
MCA department of LDRP Institute of Technology and Research was established in the year 2007-08, with a three year full time course.
Admission year 2020 onwards, MCA will be a 2 years course.
LDRP is affiliated to Kadi Sarva Vishwavidyalaya (A University established vide Gujarat State Government Act 21 of 2007 in May 2007 and approved by UGC).
Beautiful healthy green foliage covered campus located in the center of green city Gandhinagar.
24*7 Full Wi-Fi Campus with 1 Gbps Internet Connectivity.
Knowledge, Skill and Practical Based Learning and Teaching Approach by highly experienced and Enthusiastic Faculties.
Co-Curricular Activities for 360 Degree Growth of the Student.
Fees as per the fee regulatory committee.
What is the selection procedure to MCA courses @LDRP?
The Selection process is based on the score obtained in the CMAT examination for the respective academic year, and Minimum required marks in graduation, by ACPC.
Institutes can fill the vacant sheets by inviting applications from the candidates.
Candidates can apply directly to the institute for seeking such admissions.
Online Application form is available on the website,
https://www.ldrp.ac.in/mca/
Click here for an Admission form
Is it necessary for me to have prior computer knowledge?
Not necessary but prior computer knowledge can be an added advantage.
Can I get admission to the course before final degree results are published?
Yes, you can get
provisional
admission to the course.
Your admission will be confirmed once the results are published and you satisfy the eligibility criteria for MCA before the last date of admission.
What is the fee structure for an MCA course at LDRP?
2025 fee structure* Rs. 99,000/- Per Year. (* subject to change for 2026 admissions.)
What is the syllabus for MCA at Kadi Sarva Vishwavidyalaya (KSV).
The syllabus is available on the institute web site. Syllabus of Semester-III will be a part of Semester-I in the new 2-years Course. And, for Pre-requisite subjects, Bridge courses are designed by the university.
The url for syllabus is as follows.
https://www.ldrp.ac.in/mca-new-cbcs-syllabus-2018/
What are the different specializations that can be opted for MCA@LDRP?
Specialization tracks in MCA as per the syllabus by the university (KSV), are (1) Mobile Computing (2) Data Analytics, and (3) Networking.
Are there hostel facilities for boys and girls getting admission for the course?
Yes, we provide separate hostel facilities for boys and girls.
What are the placement activities?
The Institute has a strong placement cell.
The cell manages campus recruitments and arranges employers to visit the campus, to interact with the final year students and the subsequent recruitment process.
How much do I expect to earn after MCA?
Sky is the limit.
But as it is a technical field, it depends more on your technical expertise.
If you do your MCA, you may expect to get anywhere between 5 Lacs to 15 Lacs per annum in India and much more abroad.
A large number of MCAs are absorbed in good MNCs abroad after a few years of experience.
